title: Plans and subscription
lead: The free plan is yours to keep; a subscription unlocks longer charts, an unlimited calculator, backtests and real-time sync. Safety hints are always free.
now.site: The site's own account: every feature, no subscription needed.
now.ends: Canceled. The subscription lasts until {date}, then the free plan; nothing is deleted.
now.past_due: The last payment failed. Update the payment method under Manage subscription before {date}, or the plan goes back to free.
row.view: Training plan, editing, manual entries, activity list, charts of the last 90 days
row.safety: Safety hints, cut-off checks, injury red flags, heat and cold alerts
row.charts: Charts of 365 days and the whole history
buy.year_save: NT$298 less than a year of monthly payments
buy.agree: I have read and agree to the terms of service (subscription, cancellation and refunds)
buy.need_agree: Please tick the box to agree to the terms first
buy.provider: You pay on Polar's checkout page (Polar sells on our behalf as the merchant of record and e-mails your receipts). We never see your card number. The subscription renews each period; cancel any time under Manage subscription and it lasts until the period ends.
buy.sandbox: Test mode: the payment provider's test environment, nothing is charged.
closed: Subscriptions are not open yet. Once they are, you can pay here; until then everyone is on the free plan.
manage.intro: Change the card, cancel, or see receipts on Polar's subscription page.
flash.ok: Payment done: you are on the subscription now.
flash.ok_late: The payment went through; the plan takes effect within a few minutes. If it doesn't, press Refresh subscription status.
flash.cancel: The payment wasn't completed; nothing was charged.
flash.portal: Back on the plans page. A change to the subscription can take a few seconds to show.
